{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MX-015","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"material","page":1,"quote":"#"}],"comment":"The material field in the title block is a placeholder ('#') and no dimension on the drawing clearly identifies the shim's stock thickness. Without a defined material thickness, procurement cannot source the correct raw stock and manufacturing cannot verify the part. The designer must fill in the material specification and ensure the thickness dimension is present and unambiguous."
  , "recommended_correction": "Replace the '#' in the material title-block field with the actual material specification (e.g., per note N3 'M.S.') and verify that the shim thickness is explicitly dimensioned on the drawing."}]}
